senses.gloss: *to hack and break the clods of earth (v. בּוּל II; v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Raster).
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 36">Lev. R. s. 36</cite> on setting a vine <he>בּוֹלְשִׁין אותה וכ׳</he> (read <he>אותן</he>) you first break them (the large stony clods) under it and then you plant it. Cmp. <cite ref="A00165"><he>אַבְלוֹשָׁא</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (law) to search (for concealed goods &c.) to hold a visitation. Denom. בַּלְשִׁי &c.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Middot 1:7">Midd. I, 7</cite> <he>לִבְלוֹשׁ וכ׳</he> to patrol the Temple.
